blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Garden Village rose from 8 in June to 11 in October (+37.5%), and 3 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 2.6% of Burnaby’s 430 houses listed.

blocks.text: Garden Village home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

9 houses sold in Garden Village with a median price of $1,825,000 (the middle half sold between $1,588,888 and $1,850,000), taking a median of 12 days to sell at 93.4% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median $760 per square foot, a median year built of 1954 and a median lot of 6,600 square feet.

Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Garden Village?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 11 houses listed in Garden Village. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Garden Village a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Garden Village had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Garden Village from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses sold in Garden Village over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Garden Village?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Garden Village sell for?
faq.a: 9 houses sold in Garden Village between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,825,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Garden Village?
faq.a: The median was 12 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 93.4% of the last list price (11% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
